verdict.rationale: Running Next.js headlessly or in CI is a fair question for a framework with build tooling, but the evidence pack never documents non-interactive build commands, CI integration, or headless automation. The closest items are self-hosting via Node.js, Docker or static exports, and codemods for upgrades. Those cover deployment and migration, not running the product in CI for automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
